tools.name: dynamic_space
tools.intent: Discover and invoke Hugging Face Spaces as tasks (image generation, OCR, TTS, background removal); pick this to run a hosted model app.

tools.name: gr1_z_image_turbo_generate
tools.intent: Generate an image from a text prompt with the Z-Image-Turbo Space, with resolution, steps and seed controls; use for quick text-to-image output.

tools.name: hf_fs
tools.intent: Filesystem-style Hub access via hf:// URIs: list trending, search, find files and cat repo files, papers and docs; the general Hub browsing tool.

tools.name: hf_whoami
tools.intent: Report the authenticated Hugging Face account, organization memberships and credential access; read-only identity check.

tools.name: hub_repo_details
tools.intent: Get details for specific known model, dataset or Space repo ids, including dataset structure and previews; use when you already have the id.

tools.name: hub_repo_search
tools.intent: Keyword search across Hub models, datasets and Spaces with author, tag and sort filters; use to discover repos by topic rather than by exact id.
